Source   Edit  

OrchestratorAgent — per-session actor: debounce → memory → LLM → reply.

Lifecycle: Daemon spawns runOrchestrator as an asyncSpawn task (fire-and-forget). The orchestrator loops forever, one collectWithDebounce cycle per turn.

Onboarding state machine (new users): opWakeUp → send wakeup + mode keyboard → opModeChoice opModeChoice → Guided: opGuidedEnergy … opGuidedInitiative → name gen → opNameChoice → Free: conversational LLM with IDENTITY_READY: marker → opNameChoice opNameChoice → save identity → opUserName → opUserTimezone → opUserLanguage → opDone opDone → normal LLM conversation with personality-aware system prompt.

Debounce: collectWithDebounce awaits the first task message, then keeps collecting additional messages arriving within DebounceWindowMs using Chronos withTimeout. Merged text is dispatched to the LLM as a single turn.

Streaming: When a StreamFn is provided, the LLM call runs in a dedicated OS thread so SSE reading does not block the Chronos event loop. Tokens flow via a Nim Channelstring polled with sleepAsync(30ms). Every StreamFlushMs the orchestrator flushes accumulated tokens to the global outbox as an OutboundMessage with isPartial=true. The final flush has isPartial=false.
